newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi pilgrims to return home from Saudi Arabia on Thursday.
- Saudi businessman Prince al-Waleed and Planet Hollywood agree to open restaurants in 23 countries.
- Japanese trade exchanges with United Arab Emirates exceeded $13 billion in 1996.
- Trial of a Saudi arrested in Canada accused of involvement in al-Khobar bombing last year, adjourned to May 5.
- The Palestinian Authority seeks to buy Iraqi oil despite the United Nations and Washington's rejection.
- Etisalat telecommunications company of the United Arab Emirates net profit rises to 1.7 billion dirhams in 1996.
- Japan is the biggest importer of Omani oil. It imported 90.5 million barrels in 1996.
